title: Timeline
summary: An activity timeline (C40): events on a vertical line, each a .sf-featured-icon marker toned by status (or a dot), the actor as sf-avatar and a bold name, the title, a field change through sf-change, one quiet line «sf-time · text», a comment in an outline; grouped by day under block list's heading, runs folded into «Ещё N», steps done/current/upcoming, a «Показать ещё» button and a quiet line when there are none. Density from the page, sizes 1/2, 1 and 2.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: The list's accessible name, when it is not grouped and the page has no heading above it that names it

group.description: day: the events under a heading per calendar day in the reader's time zone («Сегодня», «Вчера», the weekday within a week, else the date), the days in the order the events come; none: one list

time-format.description: auto (1.1): sf-time auto -- under a day heading always the clock time («14:32»), the first hour too, since the heading names the day; ungrouped, auto in full («5 минут назад» within its threshold, «вчера, 19:40», «5 ноября»). relative: always relative. exact: the time under a day heading, the date and time ungrouped. sf-time shows the full moment in a tooltip on hover and focus, and its datetime is the ISO moment

now.description: The moment relative times and the day headings count from, ISO 8601, passed to every sf-time; empty: the reader's clock (sf-time redraws itself while relative, the list its day headings at midnight)

collapse.description: Consecutive events of one actor and one kind within a day: a run longer than this keeps its first this-many events and folds the rest into one «Ещё N» row (a rest of one event is drawn), revealed in place on a press; events without an actor and steps make no run (the focus goes to the first revealed event, expand is said). 0 folds nothing

sticky-headings.description: The day headings stay in sight while the list scrolls (block list's sticky heading, C40), the place's solid surface behind them

density.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-list-timeline-density-to-density): the density comes from the page (data-sf-density, decision C22). Until then compact writes data-sf-density="compact" on the list's root, noted in SF.deprecations; normal is the default and is removed too

size.description: The ladder rung: the sentence is the rung's line and type, the meta line and the comment label the rung below's, the marker (.sf-featured-icon) and the avatar line the rung below's. 1/2 for a side panel

heading-level.description: The level of the day headings in the page's outline

has-more.description: More events exist: the «Показать ещё» button shows after the last one, and its press asks load-more

loading.description: The next page is on its way: the button shows it is busy and asks nothing more

empty-text.description: The quiet line with no events; «Событий пока нет» / «No events yet» when not set

items.description: The events in the order to show them (newest first, as a history reads, or oldest first, as a log does), each {id, title, time?, text?, actor?, status?, icon?, href?, kind?, state?, change?, changes?}. time is an ISO 8601 date-time (with its offset) or milliseconds, drawn by sf-time. actor is a name or {name, avatar?, hue?, system?}: sf-avatar line and the name in bold at the start of the sentence (a system actor: the name only). status (success, warning, error, info; neutral by default) tones the marker: error, warning and success colour it, info is said in words. icon is the glyph on the marker (.sf-featured-icon), else the kind's (comment chat_bubble, sms phone_iphone), else a dot. kind comment puts text in an outline under the meta line. state (done, current, upcoming) draws the events as steps, current is aria-current=step. change {label, before, after} (or changes, a list) is drawn by sf-change. href makes the title a link. A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host appends the next page to it. An item without an id or a title, or with an id seen before, is left out

sf-list-timeline-navigate.summary: A person pressed an event's title link (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

sf-list-timeline-load-more.summary: A person pressed «Показать ещё» (vocabulary §5 load-more): {direction: after, after: the id of the last event shown}. The host sets loading, appends the next page to items and clears has-more when there is none

sf-list-timeline-expand.summary: A person pressed «Ещё N»: the folded events are shown in place and the focus moves to the first of them. {run: the id of the first folded event, ids: the revealed ids, count}. Nothing to answer: a host that loads a run's events lazily may use it

forbidden_client_responsibilities: loading the events or the next page (the host answers load-more)
ordering the events (the host gives them in order)

keyboard: Tab reaches each title link, each sf-time with its tooltip, each «Ещё N» row and the «Показать ещё» button in order; Enter follows a link, Enter or Space presses a button; Escape hides a time's tooltip
accessibility.focus: The list takes focus once: on the first event a «Ещё N» press revealed.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-timeline for a short history read from the top: recent server actions, an audit, a record's history, a notifications page, a job's history.
do_not: Do not use it for a chat or a log read from the bottom; sf-list-feed does that
Do not use it for the steps of a running job; sf-progress-run does that
Do not put markup in a title or a text; they are text
